lesson: The latest revision requires 15 characters for single-factor passwords and only 8 for MFA-only passwords, contradicting the old universal 8-character expectation.

action.find: 3.1.1 Passwords single-factor minimum 15 multi-factor eight maximum 64

lesson: Single-factor minimum is 15 characters, multi-factor-only minimum is 8 characters, and maximum allowance is at least 64 characters.
